items.title: Akiyoshi Toshiko — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But, she was wonderful because she taught me, more than anything, she taught me how to practice.

ctx.x: Piano teacher? Was there a piano teacher?

Oh, yes! When I went to school, Mister Lawrence Berk arranged for me to have piano lessons with Madame [Margaret] Chaloff, who was the mother of Serge Chaloff. And she was the student of a famous piano teacher, Madame Van Guelph [sp??]. And she was teaching at Boston University, so I had to go there to have a lesson. But, she was wonderful because she taught me, more than anything, she taught me how to practice. That was [??].
